name: API Server Reachable
description: Kubernetes API server responds to basic discovery requests.

name: All Nodes Ready
description: Cluster nodes report Ready condition.

name: Control Plane Pods Running
description: Control plane (e.g., linkerd, kube-system) pods are in Running state.

name: ServiceAccount Token Projection
description: Downward API service account token projection is available for pods.

name: Linkerd Sidecar Injection
description: Pods in instrumented namespaces have `linkerd-proxy` sidecars injected.

name: Prometheus Scrape Targets Healthy
description: Prometheus reports active scrape targets and no prolonged failures.

name: Grafana Connectable
description: Grafana UI endpoint responds (basic HTTP 200).

name: Vault Connectivity
description: Vault (if configured) accepts health/read requests.

name: PodRestartRate
description: No unexpected crashloop or elevated restart rates detected.

name: Control Plane Latency
description: API server request latencies are within acceptable bounds.

name: DNS Resolution
description: CoreDNS resolves cluster service names correctly.

name: Control Plane Certificate Validity
description: TLS certs used by control plane are not expired.

name: Node Disk Pressure
description: No nodes report DiskPressure condition.

name: API Authz Basic Check
description: A known namespace and pod can be listed by the current credentials.

name: Control Plane Pod Logs Accessible
description: Able to fetch recent logs from control-plane pods.

name: Secret Mounts Accessible
description: Secrets are mountable and readable by expected service accounts.

name: Time Skew
description: Node and control-plane time skew is within acceptable limits.

name: CRI Runtime Healthy
description: Container runtime on nodes (containerd/dockerd) reports healthy.

name: Network Policy Enforcement
description: Network policies are enforced and deny-by-default rules exist where expected.

name: Ingress/Egress Connectivity
description: Cluster can reach required external services and ingress responds.

name: Etcd Member Health
description: Etcd cluster members report healthy status.

name: ImagePullBackOffs
description: Detect ImagePullBackOff occurrences across namespaces.

name: PersistentVolumeCapacity
description: Monitor PV capacity and warn when usage is high.

name: PodDisruptionBudgets
description: PDBs exist for critical workloads.

name: TLS Cipher Strength
description: Control plane endpoints use modern TLS ciphers.

name: APIServer Audit Logs
description: Audit logs are being written and rotated.

name: Prometheus TSDB Retention
description: Prometheus retention configured and disk usage healthy.

name: Sidecar Proxy Versions
description: Ensure `linkerd2-proxy` versions are within supported range.

name: Image Vulnerability Scan
description: Spot-check images for known vulnerabilities if scanner available.

name: Node CPU Saturation
description: Detect nodes with sustained high CPU usage.
